task.title: 优化 CI 流水线缓存/并发/门禁对齐并收敛 Cargo 构建测试入口
task.description: 收口三类流水线与 Cargo 错落：(1) ci.yml / release.yml / lint-baseline-bootstrap 禁用 setup-rust-toolchain 重复缓存、补齐 target-test 独立 Rust 缓存、合并 Ubuntu 重复 apt-get、补 PR concurrency、在 verify 补齐 npm run build 与 src-tauri regression 测试（含 stop_registry_wave60）、在 build-cli 补齐 toolchain/PONY_RELEASE_BUILD=1/--locked/RUSTFLAGS；(2) package.json 中绕过 cargo-lane 的 cli:build/cargo:check/cargo:test/cargo:test:lib/cargo:test:regression/conformance:test 统一收敛到 invoke-rust-target.mjs + release 槽位（--heavy），并补 stop_registry_wave60；(3) cargo-lane.sh test 子命令超时放到 flock 内部且仅匹配 Cargo 子命令（默认 600s）；(4) 联动收口 B1795484554592（bin-as-module 递归+次数棘轮+--allow-growth+接入 verify 与 governance）。

evidence: CI double-cache disabled + split target-test cache + PR concurrency + single Ubuntu apt-get + verify npm build & src-tauri regression tests + release build-cli pinned toolchain/PONY_RELEASE_BUILD=1/--locked/-D warnings + cargo-lane test timeout inside flock (600s) + all package.json cargo bypasses converged onto invoke-rust-target; all specs & YAML parse PASS

bin-as-module ratchet v2: recursive scan (crates/*/tests & src-tauri/tests), comment stripping, per-file count ratchet (50 files/50 imports), --allow-growth guard, deterministic JSON without updated_at, 7-case sandbox selftest PASS, wired into verify & ponygo-governance
